findings.failure_mode: Config-blind DERIVED cache: the amenity-result cache key ignores the provider/extent configuration, so a non-default city or overridden provider host serves another configuration's cached results (r2 opus#1, terra, sol#2).
The Overpass-backed stop-lines cache key is not namespaced by config (same rule-5 miss as the amenity cache).
The Overpass-backed route-path cache key is not namespaced by config (same rule-5 miss).
configCacheTag reads NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_BBOX dynamically, which is undefined in a build-ARG container, so the tag is "" for a non-default city instead of the resolved extent (r2 opus#2).
A base URL carrying a query string or fragment passes validation and corrupts path concatenation downstream (r2 sol#3, terra#2).
An empty bbox token is coerced to 0 by Number() instead of being rejected (r2 sol#3).
No regression guard proves the derived cache key changes when a ring provider is overridden (r2 sonnet).

known_rejects.claim: assert the runtime (non-NEXT_PUBLIC) bbox / tile-archive extent against the build-time extent
known_rejects.why_rejected: Architectural (P4); mitigated by one shared variable name and a documented build-time constraint.
